WEAPON_DOMAINS.material: Coral Branch of a Distant Sea
Copper Talisman of the Forest Dew
Emblem of the Pale Star Army
Delirious Decadence of the Sacred Lord
Broken Goblet of the Pristine Sea
Sundered Relic of the Far-North Scions

REACTIONS_META.name: Vaporize
REACTIONS_META.effect: Amplifies triggering Pyro (1.5×) or Hydro (2.0×) DMG; scales with EM.

REACTIONS_META.name: Melt
REACTIONS_META.effect: Amplifies triggering Cryo (1.5×) or Pyro (2.0×) DMG; scales with EM.

REACTIONS_META.name: Overloaded
REACTIONS_META.effect: AoE Pyro explosion that shatters Geo shields and knocks light enemies back.

REACTIONS_META.name: Superconduct
REACTIONS_META.effect: AoE Cryo hit that reduces target Physical RES by 40% for 12s.

REACTIONS_META.name: Electro-Charged
REACTIONS_META.effect: Deals ticking Electro DoT while keeping both Hydro and Electro auras active.

REACTIONS_META.name: Frozen
REACTIONS_META.effect: Immobilizes enemies; enables 4pc Blizzard Strayer and Shatter.

REACTIONS_META.name: Swirl
REACTIONS_META.effect: Spreads element in AoE and triggers 4pc Viridescent Venerer (-40% RES).

REACTIONS_META.name: Crystallize
REACTIONS_META.effect: Creates an elemental shield shard; triggers Geo Resonance and Petra/Navia stacks.

REACTIONS_META.name: Burning
REACTIONS_META.effect: Sustained Pyro DoT aura; useful for Reverse Melt setups and Kinich/Emilie.

REACTIONS_META.name: Quicken / Aggravate / Spread
REACTIONS_META.effect: Quicken aura adds flat base DMG bonus to Electro (Aggravate) and Dendro (Spread) hits.

REACTIONS_META.name: Bloom
REACTIONS_META.effect: Spawns Dendro Cores that explode in AoE Dendro DMG after 6s (max 5 cores).

REACTIONS_META.name: Hyperbloom
REACTIONS_META.effect: Electro converts Dendro Cores into high-damage homing Dendro missiles (EM scaling).

REACTIONS_META.name: Burgeon
REACTIONS_META.effect: Pyro detonates Dendro Cores for heavy AoE Dendro DMG (EM scaling).
